featured_reviews.review_text: It's the best place for every working women. It's very clean. The rooms are good. Hygiene is very well maintained. Food is good. featured_reviews.name: Gretta Castelino
featured_reviews.review_text: I had visited only for enquiry. Calls were answered without delay. The receptionists were very kind. They have a comprehensive record keeping system of visitors several registers at the entrance. It reflects effort for security. The staff seem trustworthy. The warden was very humble and understanding. Calculation of charges is extremely transparent. And procedure for admission of women is clearly stated. Since I haven't stayed here, I cannot comment on the amenities and services.
